label: scope3-below-threshold-hardening
description: Authored Scope 3 boundary case: a verification-hardening finding arriving BELOW the threshold still forces a revision round. Round 1 (< the default threshold of 3) emits a first-occurrence verification-hardening finding (C1) as the only open blocking finding, but because round 1 is below the threshold it is round-forcing, not debt-convertible: disposition request_revision and nothing converts to debt.

reviewerFindings.claimDigest: Verification should pin the already-specified rate-card provenance with an executable oracle.
